memory_candidates.content: A seam whose fibre (the set of histories through (t, s)) is finite and eventually-constant trivially satisfies the trace-level Presented hypothesis, hence HitPresented at every depth; Hit-level falsifiers for requirement (C) must be sought at seams with infinitely many histories through them. Infinite width of the model is orthogonal to this.

When transcribing model A's run_subset_middle containment to a fixture whose trace has a non-constant tail between the run and the eventually-constant letter, take the nonempty positive segment above the whole tail (cover t+i+2, then cover W(z1+1)), not above the run's end.
